# Reviewer Recruitment Criteria

Recruit at least one reviewer from each lane:

| Lane | Minimum qualification | Primary challenge |
|---|---|---|
| Redistricting algorithms | Published or implemented partitioning/ensemble work | Model, objective, connectivity, seeds |
| Civil rights | VRA or racial-gerrymandering practice/research | Milligan baseline, protected evidence, remedies |
| Federalism/election law | Elections Clause and State administration expertise | Authority, preemption, standing, severability |
| Election administration | State/local election operations | Deadlines, data, staffing, interim plans |
| Statistics | MCMC, spatial statistics, or causal inference | R-hat, ESS, percentiles, cross-tool claims |
| Reproducible software | Build/provenance/supply-chain expertise | Source, lockfile, hashes, verifier independence |
| Community participation | COI, language access, public hearings | Access, conflict resolution, disparate impact |

Independence requirements:

- no authorship of the artifact under review;
- disclose funding, representation, and political conflicts;
- do not accept private corrections during the run;
- preserve failed and blocked results; and
- distinguish personal policy preference from reproducibility findings.
